name: Night | Time Dreading | Fever
source:
After an unlucky late day working at the Bakery, C.J boards the bus to go home and get some sleep. During the bus ride he meets a friendly Wolf, and disembarks to go home, only to be killed.

C.J loops back to his time on the bus, and suddenly finds himself in a haunting and horrifying scenario. Join him as he pairs with a new Wolf friend, getting to know him and helping in order to stop whoever or whatever from killing C.J again.

[From [url=https://hollow-soul-stories.itch.io/night-time-dreading-fever]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
不幸的是，在面包店工作了一天很晚后，C.J登上公交车回家睡觉。在公交车上，他遇到了一只友好的狼，他下车回家，却被杀了。

C.J回想起他在公交车上的时光，突然发现自己陷入了一个令人难以忘怀的可怕场景。加入他，与一位新的Wolf朋友配对，了解他并提供帮助，以阻止任何人或任何东西再次杀死C.J。

[来自[url=https://hollow-soul-stories.itch.io/night-time-dreading-fever]Itch.io[/url]]
